definitionZh: y CSS属性定义了相对于最近的祖先用户坐标系统的SVG形状左上角的y轴坐标,图像,视图和嵌入式视图port. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The y CSS property defines the y-axis coordinate of the top left corner of the SVG shape, image, viewport and nested viewport relative to the nearest ancestor's user coordinate system. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
